out for, procure (<ab>dat.</ab>); look for, turn to (<ab>acc.</ab>); <ab>M.</ab> (<ab>A.</ab>) take to wife

found, be there (<ab>impers.</ab>), exist. {#vidya/te#} ({#˚ti#}) there is (<ab>esp.</ab> <ab>w.</ab>
{#na#}), {#ya/TA vide/#} as it is, <ab>i.e.</ab> as usual or as well as possible. <ab>D.</ab>
{#vivitsati#} wish to find. <ab>I.</ab> {#ve/vidat, ve/vidAna#} be present. <div n="p">— {#aDi#}
supersede, supplant. <div n="p">{#anu#} find (after), get, obtain, take hold of; <ab>M.</ab>
